data.why: The repo's own synthetic_chlorella_demo.csv already matches the required CSV format (time_day, biomass_g_L, nitrate_n_mg_L) for the Guided upload / Baseline workflows.

goals: Upload a batch culture biomass/nitrate time-series and fit a Monod growth model to estimate growth rate and yield
Compare candidate mechanistic models (Monod vs Droop vs light-limitation variants) against the same data using AIC/BIC
Calibrate an OD-or-cell-count-to-dry-weight conversion from paired measurements before using it as a growth proxy
Run a light x nitrogen scenario grid to explore operating conditions and see Pareto-tagged outcomes
Check parameter sensitivity and whether a fit is being used outside its calibration conditions (TrustLens)
Export a provenance-tracked report (CSV/JSON/PDF) documenting data, model, fit and assumptions for recordkeeping

review.summary: The guided upload-to-report path is captured well. It has sensible phases and tasks, clean general wording and screens that support it, and those screens show a finished fit with identifiability flags that the replay never reached. But it covers only one of several workspaces: model comparison, OD calibration, TrustLens and the light x nitrogen planner are all missing, so the tree needs those added before filing.
